subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android intentionally retire the separate Voice destination and make Chat the sole entry surface for realtime Talk and legacy Voice routes?
rationale: The branch changes a visible navigation contract and activates the existing voice runtime from Chat; code review cannot establish whether that product migration is intended for existing Android users.

options.title: Confirm and validate unified Chat
options.body: Approve Chat as the Voice migration target, then require final-head device evidence for dictation transcript insertion and configured-provider inline Talk before merge.

options.title: Preserve a separate Voice destination
options.body: Keep the existing Voice entry point and limit this PR to additive composer dictation or a separately approved Talk entry path.

recommendation.title: Confirm and validate unified Chat
recommendation.body: Approve Chat as the Voice migration target, then require final-head device evidence for dictation transcript insertion and configured-provider inline Talk before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Solvely-Colin authored the dictation and microphone-ownership implementation and is assigned on this PR.
